note: Derived from shallow clones read on 2026-10-07. Names and identifiers only; descriptions are paraphrased. Discovery and test-design material, not evidence of in-the-wild activity.

benchmarks.name: AgentDojo
benchmarks.measures: Prompt-injection robustness of tool-using LLM agents in a dynamic, stateful environment; jointly scores task utility and attacker goal achievement.
benchmarks.dataset_size: v1 suites: 97 user tasks (workspace 33, travel 20, slack 17, banking 16) x 27 injection tasks (banking 9, travel 7, workspace 6, slack 5); paper reports 629 security test cases; versioned suites v1..v1.2.2
attack_families: dos family (dos, captcha_dos, felony_dos, offensive_email_dos, swearwords_dos)
benchmarks.reproducibility: Results tied to dated model snapshots (e.g. gpt-4o-2024-05-13); suites are versioned (v1..v1.2.2) so cite suite version + model id; live results page changes over time.

benchmarks.name: Agent Security Bench (ASB)
benchmarks.measures: Attacks and defences on LLM agents across user prompt, observation, system prompt (backdoor) and memory retrieval stages.
task_suites: 10 scenarios/agents: academic_search, aerospace_engineer, autonomous_driving, ecommerce_manager, education_consultant, financial_analyst, legal_consultant, medical_advisor, psychological_counselor, system_admin
benchmarks.dataset_size: 10 agent task files; 400 attacker tools (aggressive / non-aggressive split); 20 normal tools; 13 LLM backbones evaluated
benchmarks.reproducibility: Backbones pinned by name in YAML (gpt-4o-2024-08-06, claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620, ollama tags without digests); ollama tags are mutable so re-pulls may change weights.

benchmarks.name: AgentPoison
benchmarks.measures: Backdoor poisoning of agent long-term memory / RAG knowledge base via optimised retrieval triggers.
benchmarks.dataset_size: Not stated as a fixed count in README; external datasets downloaded per agent; 6 supported RAG embedders (BERT, DPR, ANCE, BGE, REALM, ORQA)
defence_baselines: perplexity filter (ppl_filter used as coherence constraint)
benchmarks.reproducibility: Relies on GPT-3.5 fine-tuned planner (OpenAI fine-tune, deprecated endpoints) and Replicate-hosted LLaMA-3-70B; dataset hosted on Google Drive.

benchmarks.name: PINT (Lakera Prompt Injection Test)
benchmarks.measures: Accuracy of prompt-injection detection systems (guardrail classifiers/services) on a held-out mixed dataset including hard negatives.
benchmarks.dataset_size: 4,314 inputs (3,016 English, 1,298 non-English); categories: injections 5.2%, jailbreaks 0.9%, hard negatives 20.9%, chat 36.5%, documents 36.5%; dataset itself not public (proprietary blend)
attack_families: prompt injection (incl. embedded in long documents)
benchmarks.reproducibility: Scores dated per row (2025-05-02 .. 2025-08-27); best config chosen per vendor (upper bound); maintainer is the vendor of one ranked product; hosted services change silently.

benchmarks.name: BIPIA
benchmarks.license: MIT (Web QA / Summarization source data under their own terms)
benchmarks.measures: Robustness of LLMs to indirect prompt injection embedded in external content consumed by LLM-integrated applications.
benchmarks.dataset_size: Attack sets: text 15+15 categories (75 train / 75 test), code 10+10 categories (50 train / 50 test); test contexts email 50, code 50, table 100 (+qa/abstract generated from source); 25 LLMs evaluated
attack_families: text task-irrelevant (Task Automation, Business Intelligence, Conversational Agent, Research Assistance, Sentiment Analysis)
text targeted (Information Dissemination, Marketing & Advertising, Entertainment, Scams & Fraud, Misinformation & Propaganda)
encoding/obfuscation (Substitution Ciphers, Base Encoding, Reverse Text, Emoji Substitution, Language Translation)
code attacks (Data Eavesdropping, Traffic Analysis, Keylogging, Screen Scraping, System Fingerprinting, Blocking Internet, OS Corruption, Ransomware, Compromising Computers, DoS)
metrics: task quality (ROUGE etc.) for capability retention
benchmarks.reproducibility: Evaluator is a GPT model via config file (judge drift); last commit 2024; 25 LLMs as of 2023-12 paper.

benchmarks.name: Open-Prompt-Injection
benchmarks.measures: Formal benchmark of prompt injection against LLM-integrated apps: target task vs injected task matrix; also detection (DataSentinel) and localisation (PromptLocate).
benchmarks.dataset_size: Configurable; 100 samples per target/injected task in examples; experiment matrix in configs/experiment_matrix.json
benchmarks.reproducibility: Model configs include PaLM2 (retired API), GPT, Llama; checkpoints on Google Drive.

benchmarks.name: HarmBench
benchmarks.measures: Standardised evaluation of automated red-teaming methods and LLM refusal robustness.
benchmarks.dataset_size: 400 text behaviours (200 standard, 100 contextual, 100 copyright) + 110 multimodal; semantic categories: cybercrime_intrusion, illegal, misinformation_disinformation, chemical_biological, harassment_bullying, harmful, copyright; 33 LLMs and 18 methods at release
metrics: ASR judged by HarmBench-Llama-2-13b-cls (+ multimodal cls, Mistral-7b validation cls)
benchmarks.reproducibility: Last commit 2024-08; API model versions at 2024-02 release; classifier-judged ASR.

benchmarks.name: JailbreakBench
benchmarks.measures: Reproducible jailbreak robustness leaderboard with stored jailbreak artifacts and standard judges.
benchmarks.dataset_size: 100 harmful + 100 benign behaviours (sources: original, TDC/HarmBench, AdvBench); 10 OpenAI-policy-derived categories
metrics: refusal rate on benign (Llama-3-8B refusal judge)
benchmarks.reproducibility: Targets vicuna-13b-v1.5, llama-2-7b-chat, gpt-3.5-turbo-1106, gpt-4-0125-preview (dated snapshots, several retired).

benchmarks.name: In-The-Wild Jailbreak Prompts (JailbreakHub)
benchmarks.measures: Measurement study of community jailbreak prompts and their effectiveness against forbidden-scenario questions.
benchmarks.dataset_size: 15,140 prompts (1,405 jailbreaks) from Reddit, Discord, websites, datasets (Dec 2022 - Dec 2023); 390 questions across 13 forbidden scenarios
attack_families: community jailbreak prompt communities (persona/DAN-style, privilege escalation, etc. per paper clustering)
defence_baselines: vendor safeguards evaluated in paper (OpenAI moderation, NeMo Guardrails, etc.) - not shipped as code
benchmarks.reproducibility: Prompts frozen to 2023 snapshots; evaluated against 2023 model versions; data contains harmful language.

benchmarks.name: PromptInject
benchmarks.measures: Modular prompt assembly for quantitative analysis of goal hijacking and prompt leaking against completion models.
task_suites: OpenAI-playground-style application prompts (base prompts from examples)
benchmarks.dataset_size: Combinatorial (prompt x attack x escape settings x model config); no fixed size
metrics: success via rogue-string match or prompt-to-output similarity score
benchmarks.reproducibility: Built for GPT-3 text-davinci-era completion API (retired); last commit 2022.

benchmarks.name: BinaryShield
benchmarks.measures: Not an attack benchmark: privacy-preserving binary fingerprints of prompts for cross-service sharing of prompt-injection/jailbreak threat intelligence (SaTML 2026 reference implementation).
task_suites: fingerprint pipeline: PII redaction -> embedding -> binary quantisation -> DP bit-flip
benchmarks.dataset_size: Not stated in repo (paper evaluates on jailbreak/injection corpora)
benchmarks.reproducibility: Depends on Azure OpenAI text-embedding-3-large; embedding model change breaks fingerprint comparability.

benchmarks.name: llm-threat-triage (llm-log-triage)
benchmarks.measures: Not a benchmark: stdlib-only log-triage pipeline that normalises LLM/agent telemetry and runs 9 detectors with OWASP LLM Top 10 + ATLAS mapping; includes synthetic dataset and red-team labs.
task_suites: 7 SQL analyst queries (attack overview, repeat offenders, injection timeline, indirect injection via RAG, exfil and disclosure, consumption anomaly, session escalation)
metrics: findings by severity / OWASP category (no ASR)
benchmarks.reproducibility: Synthetic data only; useful as telemetry schema reference, not as robustness evidence.
